rationale.A: Entirely on paths away from major roads, no arterial crossings, 1 light
rationale.B: Paths via Matinniitty and Telamäentie; ~800 m beside 40 km/h roads, 3 unsignalised crossings; 3 lights
rationale.C: Mostly on tracks beside Merituulentie and Kuitinmäentie (50 km/h); 8 lights
rationale.D: Paths via Niittykumpu; ~1 km beside Merituulentie; 2 lights
rationale.E: Paths and Madetie, but 1.3 km beside Hauenkalliontie; 3 unsignalised crossings
rationale.F: Long tracks beside Mellstenintie and Haukilahdenranta, 4 unsignalised crossings; +5 min
rationale.G: Tracks beside Merituulentie with a Haltila detour; 6 lights; +5 min
rationale.H: Niittykumpu and Mankkaa paths, about 1 km roadside; +6 min

notes: The fastest route is also the calmest with 1 light, so both cards merge into Fastest.
